_readme: Traits: desc (shown in tooltips), fx (merged into the effect engine, js/logic/fx.js), plus flags.

fx vocabulary (only these keys): maxEnergy(add) energyRec(mul) actEnergy(mul) actEnergyBy{service:mul} actQuality{service:mul} actBan[service ids] lustBuild(mul) lustDrop(mul) lustMax(add) lustFloor(add) recklessAt(add) noReckless(flag) moodDrift(mul) moodDelta(mul) moodRest(add) trustGain(mul) skillGain(mul) statGain(mul) lewdGain(mul) jobBonus{job:mul} clientFee(mul) classBonus{class:mul} appeal(add) propRate(mul) security(add) energyBank(add) wardrobe(add) willing(add) rep(mul) promote(mul) tidy(mul) encore(add).
gen: can be rolled for generic ladies. hidden: not shown until Appraisal Lv 3. story / personal: set by the game, not rolled. excl: traits she can't have together.

earn: lets a lady DEVELOP the trait. {count:'massage', at:40} (w.counts.<key>, e.g. svc, massage, dance, bar, promo, rowdy, rescued, encore, weeksWorked, privateSam, gifts, or svcByAct.<service id>, jobWeeks.<job id>), {stat:'popularity', at:70} (stats and skills are compared on the 0-100 scale), {trust:90}, {lewd:80}, {weeks:30} (total weeks worked), {job:'dancer', weeks:12}. Checked weekly; once eligible she has earnChance per week to develop it.
ngOnly: generic trait only rolled from cycle 2 (New Game+). ngPerk: offered to carried-over ladies in New Game+. Other agents will expand this catalogue: keep the schema.

Named ladies (characters.json / guests.json) may carry a personal 'unique': {name, desc, fx} (fx merged like a trait; shown on her sheet) and a 'body': {bust, height, figure} (ids from data/body.json; default medium / average / slim).

Shy.desc: Lewdness grows slowly; trust grows faster; less comfortable undressing.

Former Adventurer.desc: Strong at security; adventurers love her.

Elegant.desc: Nobles pay more for her company.

Romantic.desc: Time with Sam builds trust faster.

Greedy.desc: Gifts and good earnings please her more; expects higher pay.

Loyal.desc: Rarely loses trust; hard to poach.

Exhibitionist.desc: Dancing raises lewdness faster; comfortable with less clothing; needs no room for services.

Insatiable.desc: Lust builds fast and never drops very far; her lust is spent more slowly.

Slow to Warm.desc: Lust builds slowly and is easily satisfied; she never gets restless.

Modest.desc: Would rather keep her clothes on: they get pulled aside instead. Lewdness (and trust, with Sam) still brings more of them off.

Devoted.desc: Sam's lover. Never leaves; more willing with Sam; mood stays up.

Oblivious.desc: Thinks of Sam as the boy from next door. Far less willing with him until her story moves along.

Skilled Hands.desc: Years of rubbing tired shoulders: her massages are in demand.

Natural Performer.desc: The stage has stopped scaring her. People come to watch.

Bar Veteran.desc: She can read a room, and a glass, from across the floor.

Crowd Favorite.desc: Half the town knows her name.

Confidante.desc: She trusts Sam completely, and it shows: she settles easily.

Seasoned.desc: Thirty weeks on, nothing much surprises her.

Unflappable.desc: She has stared down enough pushy customers to take most things in stride.

Headliner.desc: A dozen weeks on stage and the house knows her act by heart.

Hollowmere Veteran.desc: Back for another round: she knows how the house runs.

Second Wind.desc: Carries a little extra energy into every week.

Beloved.desc: Settled, happy, and sure of her place.
